entries.title: Falling Leaf Decomposition on Forest Floor
entries.description: A stack of semi-transparent leaves falls onto a textured ground plane and slowly shrinks, darkens, and breaks into smaller particles that sink into the soil while color-coded nutrient spheres transfer into plant roots with floating labels.

entries.title: Rotting Fruit with Expanding Mold Colony
entries.description: A glossy apple sits on a table and gradually softens, its surface dimpling and darkening as fuzzy mold spheres attach, grow, and release tiny spore particles that drift, land, and start new colonies with subtle pulsing colors.

entries.title: 3D Compost Pile Breakdown
entries.description: A pile of colored blocks representing food scraps, paper, and yard waste slowly crumble into smaller cubes and spheres while swarming microbe particles attach, detach, and glow brighter as they “consume” material, with a vertical meter showing mass loss over time.

entries.title: Metal Corrosion and Flaking Rust
entries.description: A shiny metal beam stands upright and is bombarded by slow-moving oxygen spheres; when they collide, the metal surface becomes pitted, rust-colored voxels form, grow outward, and occasionally detach as flakes that fall and scatter on the floor.
